title: Safe value
description: Given a HashMap with names and ages, use Optional to look up the age of a name. If the name does not exist, show a default value of -1. Use Optional.ofNullable and orElse.
hints: Optional.ofNullable(edades.get("Luis")) creates an Optional from a value that can be null
.orElse(-1) returns the value or -1 if the Optional is empty
HashMap.get() returns null if the key does not exist
solutionExplanation: Optional.ofNullable() creates an Optional that can be empty if the value is null. orElse() provides a default value when the Optional is empty. This avoids NullPointerExceptions.
expectedOutput:
Age of Luis: 30
Age of Pedro: -1

title: Operation chain
description: Given an Optional with a String, apply a chain of operations: if the value is present and not empty, convert to uppercase and append "!" at the end. If the String is null or empty, throw an exception with orElseThrow.
hints: .map(s -> s.toUpperCase()) applies a transformation if the value exists
.filter(s -> !s.isEmpty()) validates that the string is not empty
.orElseThrow(() -> new RuntimeException("empty text")) throws an exception if there is no value
solutionExplanation: The chain filter -> map -> map -> orElseThrow processes the value step by step. filter validates that it is not empty, map transforms, and orElseThrow throws an exception if at any point it runs out of value.
expectedOutput:
Text2 error: empty or null text
Text3 error: empty or null text
Text1: HOLA MUNDO!

title: Optional with nullable
description: Given a list of Optional<String> (some empty, some with value), create a stream that: 1) Filters only those with a value (not empty), 2) Extracts the value with .get(), 3) Filters those that are not empty in content, 4) Converts to uppercase, 5) Prints each one and how many remain.
hints: Optional::isPresent is a method reference that checks if the Optional has a value
Optional::get extracts the value from the Optional
Full chain: filter -> map -> filter -> filter -> map -> forEach
solutionExplanation: The stream processes the list of Optionals step by step: isPresent filters the empty ones, get extracts the value, the following filters remove empty strings and the literal "null", and map converts to uppercase. peek prints without consuming the stream.
